verdict.rationale: Filee documents an official `filee convert` command that accepts files, wildcards or folders with `--to <format>` or `--preset`, using the app's own engines. It also has script-friendly `--json` output and defined exit codes (0–3), which suit agent and automation use. The probe confirms the CLI is documented in the official GitHub README. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as described, and documentation of any command surface beyond the single `convert` subcommand.
